definition: Today's documented research behind Centaur Worker Models.
description:

Carnegie Mellon's Open Learning Initiative proved adaptive courseware doubles learning rates. Together these programs form the pairing designs foundation that Centaur Worker Models will build on — the model logistics results, the skill complement methods, and the institutional memory.

title: Centaur Worker Models Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Centaur Worker Models: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Centaur Worker Models — models pairing humans with AI.

Phase 1 — Prove (pairing designs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (model logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (skill complement): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (productivity proof): model hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and workers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
